Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From a83de90658280611933d6b3e5044726f63a953f2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Yonghong Song <yhs@fb.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Feb 2019 22:18:16 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] selftests/bpf: set unlimited RLIMIT_MEMLOCK for
 test_sock_fields

This is to avoid permission denied error. A lot of systems
may have a much lower number, e.g., 64KB, for RLIMIT_MEMLOCK,
which may not be sufficient for the test to run successfully.

Fixes: e0b27b3f97b8 ("bpf: Add test_sock_fields for skb->sk and bpf_tcp_sock")
Signed-off-by: Yonghong Song <yhs@fb.com>
Acked-by: Song Liu <songliubraving@fb.com>
Signed-off-by: Daniel Borkmann <daniel@iogearbox.net>

diff --git a/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_sock_fields.c b/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_sock_fields.c
index 9bb58369b481..bc8943938bf5 100644
--- a/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_sock_fields.c
+++ b/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_sock_fields.c
@@ -14,6 +14,7 @@
 #include <bpf/libbpf.h>
 
 #include "cgroup_helpers.h"
+#include "bpf_rlimit.h"
 
 enum bpf_array_idx {
 	SRV_IDX,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `test_sock_fields.c`**
   - Added an include directive for the header file `bpf_rlimit.h`. This inclusion is likely intended to provide access to functions or definitions related to resource limits, specifically for managing memory locking limits.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `test_sock_fields.c` is aimed at addressing a permission denied error that can occur due to insufficient memory lock limits (RLIMIT_MEMLOCK) on various systems. By including `bpf_rlimit.h`, the test is likely preparing to set or modify the RLIMIT_MEMLOCK to an unlimited value, ensuring that the test can run successfully without being hindered by system-imposed memory restrictions. This change is directly related to the bug fix mentioned in the patch description, which aims to enhance the reliability of the `test_sock_fields` test.
